recognize_zh: 雙重酯酶染色中，大多數母細胞胞質呈瀰漫棕紅色（非特異性酯酶，α-naphthyl butyrate esterase 陽性），僅少數細胞呈藍色（chloroacetate esterase 陽性的顆粒球系前驅細胞），提示單核球系白血病。
features: Large blasts with round to slightly irregular outlines and abundant cytoplasm
Diffuse brown-red cytoplasmic reaction for nonspecific (alpha-naphthyl butyrate) esterase in the majority of blasts
Rare cells (two in field) with granular blue cytoplasmic reaction for chloroacetate esterase, marking granulocytic precursors
Double-positive cells not evident; the two lineages stain separately
Background of unstained red cells and a few smudged/disrupted cells with faint brown staining
describe_en: Cytochemical double esterase stain of a smear shows a population of large blasts, the majority of which demonstrate diffuse brown-red cytoplasmic nonspecific (alpha-naphthyl butyrate) esterase activity. Only rare cells show blue granular chloroacetate esterase activity, consistent with residual granulocytic precursors. Findings support monocytic differentiation of the blasts and are consistent with acute monoblastic/monocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: AMML requires at least 20% neutrophil lineage cells, which would show many more chloroacetate esterase-positive (blue) cells than the rare ones seen here.
Granulocytic blasts are chloroacetate esterase- and MPO-positive and lack diffuse nonspecific esterase activity.
Megakaryoblasts may show focal nonspecific esterase, but the reaction is fluoride-resistant and dot-like rather than diffuse, and they express CD41/CD61.
Lymphoblasts are negative for nonspecific esterase (or show only focal dot positivity) and lack chloroacetate esterase.
